title: Shipped my first Steam game using AI tools
author: xeurik
selftext:
I’ve been making small prototype games for a while, but I finally managed to ship something properly on Steam.

It’s called [Click and Cast. ](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4827230/Click_and_Cast/)

The game isnt huge. It is a small incremental/clicker game, but I’m honestly pretty proud of it because I made it part-time after work over the last couple of weeks.

I used **Godot** since I’m already comfortable with it. For AI tools, I used Claude mostly to think through the game structure and planning, Codex for coding help, and ChatGPT for sprite ideas / rough assets. A lot of the art still needed cleanup, so I edited the sprites myself in Aseprite to make everything fit together.

The biggest thing AI helped with was momentum. 

Usually after work i am out of energy, but having AI is like having a team or partners who work very efficiently, and the momentum pushes you further. 

It’s not a huge game or anything, but seeing my own game live on Steam feels really cool. 

I love the era in which we are right now
